status: Read by the rebuild from its image (routemaker.hazards, pipeline.hazard_layer) when the segments and the route network are written. Routes price these roads as LTS 4 (never a path); a route that rides one marks and names it; the road keeps its stress rating.

hazards.source: The owner, 2026-10-19 ("the cobblestones in Georgetown"). The Georgetowner, "O and P Streets Project to Mark Completion in a Few Weeks" (https://georgetowner.com/?p=93557): "O Street and P Street, west of Wisconsin Avenue to 35th Street, are the last spots in Washington when trolley tracks can be seen"; DDOT's O and P Streets Rehabilitation Project relaid the granite setts and refitted the tracks.

The owner, 2026-10-19 ("the streetcar rails on H street"). DC Streetcar's H Street/Benning Road line ran from Union Station along H Street NE and Benning Road NE to Oklahoma Avenue and ceased operations on 31 March 2026 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/H_Street/Benning_Road_Line); its rails stay in the street. A backstop for OSM's tram lines, which the rebuild also matches onto the road.
